'''Philipp Lengsfeld''' (born 21 March 1972) is a German politician, formerly of the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|Christian Democratic Union]] (CDU).

== Life ==

Born in [[East Berlin]], Lengsfeld is the oldest son of German politician and civil rights activist [[Vera Lengsfeld]]. He grew up in [[East Germany]]. In 2001, he joined the [[center-right]] [[CDU (Germany)|CDU]].

From 2013 to 2017, he was a member of the [[Bundestag]].

He left the CDU in 2023.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Latz |first1=Christian |title=„Die Partei schuldet mir nichts“: Berliner Politiker Philipp Lengsfeld tritt aus der CDU aus |trans-title=‘The party owes me nothing": Berlin politician Philipp Lengsfeld resigns from the CDU |url=https://www.tagesspiegel.de/berlin/die-partei-schuldet-mir-nichts-berliner-politiker-philipp-lengsfeld-tritt-aus-der-cdu-aus-10080790.html |access-date=16 January 2025 |work=Der Tagesspiegel |date=1 July 2023 |language=German}}</ref>

== Positions ==

Lengsfeld belonged to the [[right-wing]] of his party, the so-called ''Berliner Kreis''.<ref name="berlinerkreisinderunion">{{cite web|url=http://www.berlinerkreisinderunion.de/berliner-kreis/ueber-uns/#mitglieder|title=Ziele|website=Berliner Kreis|access-date=13 September 2018}}</ref>

He opposes same-sex marriage<ref>{{citation|surname1=Werner van Bebber, Sabine Beikler|periodical=Der Tagesspiegel Online|title=Homo-Ehe spaltet Berliner CDU|issn=1865-2263|date=30 June 2015|language=de|url=https://www.tagesspiegel.de/berlin/queerspiegel/streit-um-die-ehe-fuer-alle-homo-ehe-spaltet-berliner-cdu/11991776.html|access-date=4 September 2018
}}</ref> and is critic of [[Angela Merkel]]s [[Politics of climate change|climate policy]].<ref>{{citation|periodical=Die Zeit|title=Klimaschutz: CDU-Rechte fordern Abschied von deutschen Klimazielen|location=Hamburg|issn=0044-2070|date=3 June 2017|language=de|url=http://www.zeit.de/politik/deutschland/2017-06/klimaschutz-pariser-abkommen-cdu-csu-berliner-kreis|access-date=7 June 2017
}}</ref>
